QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_41

answer.text: Protecting investor details, deals, transactions and confidential fund/investor information except for authorized or legally/contractually required purposes

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM XIX-A (pp. 271-273, 277), the distributor agreement includes confidentiality and data-privacy clauses for fund and investor data. Distributors should implement confidentiality policies so that investor and investment-manager data is not compromised; employees should disclose information only when necessary and authorised, and legitimate disclosures require a regulatory or contractual basis with proper authorisation. The Trap: Free sharing, publication, or disclosure to competitors breaches both the distributor agreement and SEBI good-practice standards, and exposes the distributor to legal and reputational risk. Note: When in doubt about disclosing investor information, distributors should escalate to the Compliance Officer for written authorisation before any release.
